description: Two consecutive binance customer withdrawals within a 2-minute window that funded the operator's operational wallets. These are the primary on-chain attribution point. Binance itself is not accused of anything — a customer used their service. Independent verification is a single query against binance's internal payout ledger for the 2025-07-22 13:47-13:49 UTC window.
